validation_cer_still_improving_meaningfu.evidence: Only one validation pass exists for a single-epoch run, so validation CER's own trend cannot be observed directly. The train CER proxy (measured every 500 optimizer steps, optimizer_trace.csv) was still declining steadily through the very last logged interval: step 33500->34000->34500->35000->35111 gave train_CER 0.28161->0.27949->0.27741->0.27537->0.27491 -- a smooth, undiminished decline with no visible flattening.

training_remains_stable.evidence: No NaN/inf detected in train_loss/val_loss/val_cer (checked via _has_nan_or_inf on the final EpochResult). No OOM signature in stderr_tail. Loss declined monotonically for the entire logged trace (95.3 at step 500 -> 32.0 at train_end).

no_strong_overfitting_signal.evidence: held-out val_CER_metric (0.1940 in-training / 0.1918 independent) is LOWER than the final train_CER_metric (0.2749) -- the opposite of an overfitting signature. This is consistent with dropout being active during training-mode forward passes but not during validation/inference-mode passes (D50 dropout layers throughout the recommended VGSL spec), not evidence of memorization.

scratch_performance_approaching_fine_tun.evidence: Held-out corpus CER: Experiment 2 = 0.1918 vs Experiment 0 = 0.1728 and Experiment 1 = 0.1747. Gap of 0.0171-0.0190 after exactly one epoch from random initialization, against baselines that started from a checkpoint pretrained on a much larger prior corpus. This is a materially closer result than a naive prior would predict for one epoch from scratch.

trajectory_suggests_additional_learning_.evidence: Directly inferred from the undiminished train-CER decline rate at epoch end (no plateau) -- the standard signal that a model has not yet reached its capacity-limited plateau. Not directly measured (no epoch 2 has been run), so classified as INFERRED, not MEASURED.

architecture_or_input_compatibility_susp.evidence: Bounded preflight (Phase 6) verified the architecture parses, instantiates, and runs real forward/backward passes with the real CTCLoss before launch. The real run then completed 35,111 real optimizer steps (99.9% of the full corpus) without error.

reason: All five RUN_SCRATCH_EPOCH_2 criteria are met (still-improving trajectory, stable training, no overfitting signal, approaching the fine-tuned baselines, and continued-learning trajectory); none of the four STOP criteria triggered. The 0.017-0.019 CER gap to the pretrained baselines after one epoch, combined with an undiminished improvement rate at epoch end, is evidence FOR continuing, not evidence that scratch training is inferior -- consistent with the explicit instruction not to treat one epoch from random initialization as the architecture's ceiling.
not_a_recommendation_to_run_epoch_2_auto: This decision file records a recommendation only. Per the brief's explicit instruction, no second epoch was started -- see the combined report's 'THIS COMMAND WAS NOT EXECUTED' final line for the exact command that would start it.
caveat: This decision concerns whether Experiment 2 (native architecture, scratch init) merits further training on its own trajectory. It does not conclude that scratch training is or will be superior to fine-tuning -- see loghi_experiments_0_1_2_report.md's interpretation section for the full, hedged discussion.
